FAQ

## Frequently asked questions

Clusy is an agent-native notebook platform for machine learning and data science. You describe the outcome you want in plain language, and the Clusy agent plans the work, writes and runs notebook cells on cloud CPUs or GPUs, and returns results you can inspect, edit, and re-run. Every step stays visible in a real notebook, so you keep full code-level control.

Traditional notebooks give you an empty editor; Clusy gives you an agent that does the work in the notebook with you. It sources and inspects data, selects architecture and compute, executes end-to-end, and supports branching so you can fork a notebook and compare experiments side by side. The output is still a real notebook you can read, edit, and share.

The Free plan includes the Auto model for fast, low-cost everyday work. Plus adds open models such as DeepSeek and Kimi. Pro and Max unlock every model, including Anthropic Claude (Sonnet and Opus) and OpenAI GPT.

Every plan runs on managed cloud sandboxes. Free starts with an 8 vCPU / 8 GB RAM CPU sandbox. Plus adds entry GPUs (T4, L4, A10) up to 24 GB VRAM, Pro adds mid-tier GPUs (L40S, A100) up to 80 GB VRAM, and Max unlocks top-end H100 and H200 GPUs up to 141 GB VRAM with up to 128 GB sandbox RAM.
